def min_Swaps(s1: str, s2: str) -> int:
    if len(s1) != len(s2):
        return -1
    if s1.count('1') != s2.count('1'):
        return -1
    mismatches = sum(1 for x, y in zip(s1, s2) if x != y)
    return mismatches // 2

assert min_Swaps("1101", "1110") == 1
